text:
Based on the fundus findings of granular yellow-white opacities and hemorrhages in the context of severe immunosuppression (CD4 36/mm3), these are highly characteristic of Cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis rather than tuberculosis. Given your history of AIDS and the specific retinal presentation, I am confident in this assessment.
